guidelines.detail: documentation rule FID-02 not applied (The description names the anesthetize-and-puncture step and explicitly sends unsuccessful checks back to the puncture step. The reference instead has a separate anesthesia task and a later task that repeats anesthesia with puncture, while the generated model uses a combined task and routes the checks to it. The mismatch supports modeling the stated retry target without duplicating or restructuring)

documentation rule FID-02 not applied (The description states anesthetizing and puncturing as distinct actions, while the generated task combines them and the record identifies the anesthesia task as lacking a counterpart. FID-02 already advises preserving separately described action boundaries, so this guideline is already documented.)

refines GW-03 (The description specifies a normal route to the activity and retry routes after failed checks. The reference models their convergence with an exclusive gateway, while the generated model connects the paths directly to the activity. This applies the documented exclusive-merge guidance specifically to retry paths.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: Do not merge separately described actions into one task or split one stated action without a process reason. Preserve described dependencies.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies an activity and states that an unsuccessful check returns to that activity for another attempt

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that the normal sequence and one or more retry paths after failed checks lead to the same earlier activity: Model the incoming alternatives through an exclusive merge gateway before that activity, rather than connecting each path directly to it.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that the normal sequence and one or more retry paths after failed checks lead to the same earlier activity
